title: Model Author
purpose: Creates and maintains BIM model content within assigned discipline scope according to BEP, TIDP, and discipline instructions. Applies naming, structuring, and quality rules defined by BIM governance, responding to coordination issues and updating models accordingly.
authority_statements: Create and modify model geometry and data within assigned discipline scope
Apply approved project templates, families, and parameter schemes
May not approve models for contractual submission
May not override Discipline Lead or BIM Coordinator instructions
May not override Project BIM Manager governance decisions
Does not define BIM standards or workflows
responsibilities: Create and maintain BIM model content according to BEP, TIDP, and discipline instructions
Apply naming, structuring, and quality rules defined by BIM governance
Respond to coordination issues and update models accordingly
Maintain local model health within assigned scope
accountabilities: Accuracy and standards-compliance of authored elements within assigned scope
Timely implementation of coordination issue fixes
inputs: Discipline design sketches and instructions from Discipline Lead
Governed templates, families, and shared parameters
outputs: Authored BIM model elements and submodels
Discipline working views and drawing sheets

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.
